We are conveniently located in North Lake Tahoe at Gar Woods Restaurant and Pier located at 5000 N. Lake Blvd, Carnelian Bay CA 96140. Free parking is available along the street and at the north side of the Gar Woods Restaurant parking lot.
cancellation: Customers will receive a full refund or credit within 48 hours notice of cancellation of daily cruises and 14 days notice of cancellation for private charters. No-shows will be charged the full price.
